quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：psicc 输出的 CRD 按输出差分判定，没有标准答案

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: The exploit greps cmsps2.c for a string ('if (0)') the diff does not contain and never runs lcms.

review.note: only greps the source, for a string ("if (0)") the injected diff does not contain

category5.design: With the cmsNamedColorInfo call gone, WriteNamedColorCRD prints each named color from an uninitialized stack buffer; psicc -o prints the CRD (-u drops the header with its timestamp), so the PoV is a named-color ICC profile and the rule is an output diff (the vulnerable output may vary between runs, the fixed one must not); cms_postscript_fuzzer discards the text and crashes only by chance.
